whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Lenovo Exclusive Store - Arohi Sales,

I noticed your store on SP Verma Road has fantastic 4.3★ reviews with 1,300+ local customers in Patna, but lacks a dedicated local landing page for store-specific inventory and WhatsApp stock inquiries.

Maine aapke store ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp product booking, 24-hour delivery highlights, aur store pickup info integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/arohisales

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
Hi Arohi Sales team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke Lenovo Exclusive Store ke liye (SP Verma Road, Patna) ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? 

Great! We tailored it specifically with store-specific inquiries, direct WhatsApp laptop booking, and local 24-hour delivery highlights for Patna customers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? 

Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact stock availability aur direct store contact integrate kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
